# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Use this section to tell people about which versions of your project are
currently being supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Main    | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security issues or vulnerabilities by opening a private issue or contacting the maintainers directly.
Do not open public issues for severe security vulnerabilities to ensure the safety of all users.
We will try to respond to the issue within 48 hours.
